links.surface: أبو صالح عبد الله بن صالح

notes: the saying is the story told on Salim's line ("بينما عمر بن الخطاب يخطب"); Umar is its subject, not a transmitter
«وروى مالك، هذا الحديث» is a second route; «هذا الحديث» names the matn, not a link
after the saying, Tirmidhi's commentary names «أبيه» (Salim's father) as the other version's line, and «محمد» (al-Bukhari) comments; these are not routes
